canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Huntington National Bank denied {value} of its 2,766 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Huntington National Bank decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Huntington National Bank will deny any specific future application with 26.3% probability
Huntington National Bank is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Huntington National Bank discriminates or violates law
26.3% applies to Huntington National Bank's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
